notes.title: Patch release cancelled
notes.notes:
First of all we apologize for this silence in the last few months, many things have happened in Luminy Studios.

[b]Why the patch is cancelled[/b]
Some members of the team have changed and our priorities have also changed. Now we are immersed in a new project and all our efforts are focused in this task.

In addition to this, we thought it necessary to fix many errors, perhaps too many. Our time is limited because we don’t do this professionally and we have decided to cancel the patch mainly for this reason, lack of time. 

Perhaps in the future we can update Bloodwood Reload, but at this moment is not possible.

[b]From this moment we will not give more support unless the problems are extremely serious preventing the installation of the game or play normally. Any other request will be rejected directly.[/b]

Again our apologies and thanks for your patience and comprehension.

notes.title: Bloodwood Reload will be released on 31st october on Zodiac Store, Itch.io and GameJolt and 2th november on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
we solved the issue with our pc and we fixed most bugs found.
Maybe you can find more some minor bugs but we decided not lose more time in a free project, then Bloodwood Reload will be released on 31st october on Zodiac Store, Itch.io and GameJolt and 2th november on Steam.
This will be our gift for the Halloween day.
Thanks a lot for your interest in our project.
Enjoy!
